mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_outbox (event_id, payment_id, attempt_id, event_type, schema_version, payload, status, attempt_count, available_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{paymentId}, #{attemptId}, #{eventType}, #{schemaVersion}, #{payload}, 'READY', 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_outbox WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY locked_until, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', claim_token = #{claimToken}, locked_until = TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND, #{leaseMicros}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'READY' AND available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND attempt_count < #{maxAttempts}

UPDATE payment_outbox SET status = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), last_error = NULL, claim_token = NULL, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_token = #{claimToken}

UPDATE payment_outbox SET status = CASE WHEN #{parked} THEN 'PARKED' ELSE 'READY' END, available_at = TIMESTAMPADD(MICROSECOND, #{delayMicros}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)), last_error = #{error}, claim_token = NULL, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_token = #{claimToken}
AND locked_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
